description: US time zone boundaries for the RidgeCast apps, generated by shared/tools/build_timezones.py. Do not edit by hand. Each ring is a flat list [lon, lat, lon, lat, ...] without the closing point; the first ring of a polygon is its outer boundary and the rest are holes. bbox is [min lon, min lat, max lon, max lat]. Contains information from timezone-boundary-builder, which is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
